internet_connectivity.39: Good 4G and broadband in most parts.

local_culture.4: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities, with deep ritual and philosophical traditions.
local_culture.39: Core Hindu pilgrimage city with centuries-old traditions and scholarship.

local_customs.4: Dress modestly; remove shoes in temples; do not photograph cremations without explicit permission.
local_customs.39: Dress modestly, remove footwear at temples and be mindful at cremation ghats.

39.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Varanasi

off_season.39: Peak summer and some monsoon periods

rainfall_pattern.4: Monsoon June-September; Ganga level can rise significantly.
rainfall_pattern.39: Ganga water levels vary with monsoon; boat routes may change.

recent_developments.4: Major riverfront and infrastructure upgrades as part of Kashi development projects.
recent_developments.39: New Kashi Vishwanath corridor and improved ghat infrastructure.

road_connectivity.4: Good highway connections to major UP cities.
road_connectivity.39: Good highway and rail links from major North Indian cities; city traffic can be congested near old town.

safety_notes.4: Busy and crowded; keep valuables secure; be cautious with touts offering boat rides or ‘special darshan’.
safety_notes.39: Crowds and narrow alleys require alertness; use trusted boats and guides.

special_considerations.4: Crowds around main ghats and temple; strong sights and smells at cremation ghats; respect photography restrictions.
special_considerations.39: Old city lanes are narrow and crowded; keep valuables secure; respect photography etiquette, especially around cremation ghats.

suggested_itinerary.4: Day 1: Evening Ganga Aarti and ghats; Day 2: Sunrise boat ride, Kashi Vishwanath and old city; Day 3: Sarnath excursion and quieter ghats.
suggested_itinerary.39: Day 1: Evening Aarti and ghats; Day 2: Sunrise boat and temples; Day 3+: Old city walks, Sarnath day trip or additional ghats.

sustainability_notes.4: River-cleaning and ghat conservation underway; support operators who follow waste and pollution norms.
sustainability_notes.39: Ganga cleanliness and ghats’ waste management are key; avoid plastic and use authorised boats.

unique_experiences.4: Ancient ghats, ritual bathing, cremation ghats and intense spiritual atmosphere.
unique_experiences.39: One of the world’s oldest living cities with intense spiritual rituals along Ganga ghats and maze-like old lanes.

user_reviews_summary.4: Intense but unforgettable experience; spiritual and photogenic but can feel overwhelming.
user_reviews_summary.39: Described as intense and unforgettable; many find it transformative despite congestion.
